purpose: Read-only CPU original-JPEG preprocessing latency and fidelity probe; active training pipeline was not modified.

methodology.sample_selection: 40 evenly spaced CSV positions including first and last
methodology.balanced_method_order: Cyclic offset by image position and repeat
methodology.measurement: perf_counter wall time around source file read, decode, preprocessing and tensor creation; comparisons excluded
limitations: Local Windows laptop measurements during concurrent training; CPU scheduling contention may affect tail latency.
OS file cache is warm; measurements are not a cold-disk benchmark.
No model forward or GPU transfer is measured; T4 single-image end-to-end 100 ms still requires real hardware measurement.
40 images are a deployment diagnostic sample, not proof of fidelity across the whole dataset.

methods.dataset_baseline: Current CXRDataset(frame,320,False,None)[i]: exif_transpose and full RGB conversion before thumbnail512 LANCZOS; final bilinear resize/pad/normalize.
methods.grayscale_thumbnail_before_rgb: Keep original source mode through exif_transpose and thumbnail512 LANCZOS(default reducing_gap2), then convert RGB; final transforms unchanged.
methods.lazy_thumbnail_gap2: Call source.thumbnail512 LANCZOS reducing_gap2 before exif_transpose/RGB, permitting automatic JPEG draft decode; final transforms unchanged.
methods.lazy_thumbnail_gap3: Same lazy thumbnail with reducing_gap3; final transforms unchanged.
methods.explicit_draft_512: Call source.draft(None,(512,512)) before exif_transpose, thumbnail512 LANCZOS in source mode, then RGB; final transforms unchanged.

sources.supports: draft configures JPEG loading before decoding; it has no effect after pixels are loaded.
thumbnail supports reducing_gap and automatically calls draft where possible; larger reducing_gap trades speed for fidelity.
JPEG draft can decode at one-half, one-quarter or one-eighth dimensions.

recommendations: Keep the active training and validation preprocessing unchanged for this run.

If the grayscale-thumbnail candidate is pixel-identical across broader validation, consider deploying only that source-mode-preserving operation order, with explicit handling/fallback for non-L/RGB modes.
JPEG draft candidates change pixels and may subtly change geometry; evaluate complete Study-level validation predictions before using them with a trained checkpoint.
Confirm T4 latency including raw JPEG decoding, resize/normalize, device transfer, forward pass and output conversion at batch size one.

initial_single_pass_baseline_ms.note: Separate first diagnostic pass before the balanced 3-repeat comparison; retained to show load-sensitive latency variation.

recommended_candidate.name: grayscale_thumbnail_before_rgb
recommended_candidate.deployment_scope: Candidate for future source-mode L/RGB preprocessing after active training finishes and whole-valid parity is checked; no implementation was changed.

end_to_end_measurement_contract.timed_input: Original JPEG file path from the 40 fixed, uniformly selected valid CSV rows; cache_root=None.
end_to_end_measurement_contract.timed_output: CPU NumPy vector of ten sigmoid probabilities for one image.
included: Batch dimension creation and CPU-to-GPU transfer
AMP float16 model forward, float32 sigmoid
additional_reporting_recommended: Per-image elapsed durations and Dicom IDs, not only aggregate quantiles.
Mean, median, p90, p95, maximum and checkpoint file size.
Python/PyTorch/Pillow/CUDA/GPU driver versions and input-size settings.
Preprocessing implementation hash or named version, with parity evidence if changed.
Separate cold-disk and warm-file-cache results when storage behavior matters.
Record per-image endpoint and Study-level multi-image endpoint separately if organizer wording is ambiguous.
end_to_end_measurement_contract.status: No GPU inference measurements performed in this probe; current laptop CPU numbers do not certify T4 latency.
